duration_note: Estimation au débit réel de la première génération, puis fourchette 106–123 mots/minute. Le MP3 régénéré devra être mesuré pour confirmer 2h minimum et 2h30 maximum.
editorial_notes: Conserver une enquête sur les auteurs et les intentions du projet, puis distinguer refuge, coercition initiale et décisions ultérieures. Le chapitre 19 est condensé par extraction de paragraphes entiers ; les identités, proposition et conséquence sont conservées. Aucun mot nouveau dans le script. Les faits et le périmètre des sources sont ceux du script original ; cet audit porte sur la coupe éditoriale.

Catalogue des reliques et histoire familiale de Hanna
Inventaire de la Legacy et décryptage de Quinn

before_last_two_sentences: Their lives depend on a building they didn't choose, maintained by people who weren't given its full history.
That's where the distance between the proposed refuge and the inherited government first becomes tangible.
after_first_two_sentences: George's map gives Juliette a way to think about the space beneath Mechanical before she can move through it.
The silo she knows has stairs, landings and workplaces, with people assigned to keep each part running.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent : la question de l’origine reçoit une première trace physique. George, Juliette et Mechanical sont présentés dans les passages gardés.

before_last_two_sentences: George finds a question there that Juliette carries after him.
By the time Lukas enters the hidden passage, the accepted bottom of the silo has become a place someone can pass beyond.
after_first_two_sentences: Bernard opens the Order when Juliette's survival leaves him facing a situation the residents of Silo 18 weren't supposed to encounter.
A cleaner has gone outside, passed beyond the familiar view, and failed to die where everyone can see her.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord de chapitre cohérent : le passage inférieur ferme son enquête matérielle ; Bernard et l’Order ouvrent une autre catégorie de preuves. Son paragraphe réintroduit la survie de Juliette.

before_last_two_sentences: Each man has a text he can use, a task attached to it, and limits on what it tells him.
Below them, Knox and Shirley have to survive the accusation that Bernard's reading has helped set in motion.
after_first_two_sentences: Helen Drew meets Daniel Keene in a Washington bar, in a city where people can still go out for a drink above ground.
The closing Before Times sequence of season two gives the past an ordinary setting.
join_reviews.judgment: Changement temporel explicite et compréhensible : la nouvelle scène nomme Helen, Daniel, Washington et la saison deux avant de dérouler leur enquête.

before_last_two_sentences: They present the project as a human seed bank, built to carry a surviving population through catastrophe.
Inside that population will be people who must maintain the refuge, raise families there, and live with the arrangements its builders leave behind.
after_first_two_sentences: Charlotte has already encountered the danger being discussed.
At the meeting with Stenson and Thurman, the attack on her squad is identified with the nanoweapons behind the preservation proposal.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord causal conservé : le danger discuté est celui des nanoweapons déjà nommé au dîner. Charlotte a été présentée au chantier ; sa réaction suit la proposition.

before_last_two_sentences: When Victor encounters Troy, the audience can still recognize Daniel.
And when Helen persists in Daniel's recollection, his life before the silo continues to affect the man who has just awakened inside it.
after_first_two_sentences: Susan is Charlotte, Daniel's sister, and that gives her encounter with Troy a history he can't fully bring into the room.
The audience can connect the people in Silo 1 to the siblings in the Before Times.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord direct : le réveil de Daniel/Troy précède l’identification autonome de Susan/Charlotte.

before_last_two_sentences: He meets Susan within the operating community of the silo project, where both have names and responsibilities that belong to their present lives.
For Charlotte, the family connection now exists inside an arrangement that makes it difficult to approach her brother as someone who knows her.
after_first_two_sentences: The distinction becomes practical when the residents of Silo 17 leave their silo.
Their departure reaches Silo 1 as a situation requiring a response.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord interne relu : « The distinction » renvoie encore à la différence entre le lien familial connu du public et la connaissance fragmentée de Troy. La sortie de Silo 17 donne immédiatement son application.

before_last_two_sentences: Their family relationship doesn't prevent the institution from treating her refusal as an offense.
Troy remains able to proceed, while Susan loses her freedom to participate on the terms she was attempting to defend.
after_first_two_sentences: Silo 1 has people operating the system Bernard knows as the Algorithm.
By the end of the third season, that name belongs to an arrangement with human participants, including Victor and Troy.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent : l’arrestation ferme l’exemple familial, puis le texte élargit la discussion aux opérateurs du système. Aucun pronom ne dépend des paragraphes retirés.

before_last_two_sentences: When those survivors eventually face danger beyond the building, they face a different mechanism.
The pipe inside Silo 17 has already been stopped.
after_first_two_sentences: Susan proposes targeting the sheriff so the people leaving Silo 17 will retreat.
Her suggestion gives Troy a different response to the crowd outside.
join_reviews.judgment: Continuité conservée : le Safeguard interne est arrêté ; l’alternative extérieure de Susan introduit le choix menant aux drones. Les deux mécanismes restent distincts.

before_last_two_sentences: The latest note joins the others.
Victor has a continuing record; Troy still has a question.
after_first_two_sentences: Stenson and Thurman describe the underground project as a way to preserve human beings against the danger of nanoweapons.
Their human seed-bank proposal gives the silos a purpose that fits their physical scale: people could survive below ground while conditions above threatened their existence.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord de synthèse cohérent : les notes sur Helen ferment le cas humain, puis les deux explications reprennent la proposition des fondateurs en nommant leurs auteurs.
